messages:
Tess: Quick standup: drafting a partner playbook for our LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter + gateway integration. Goal: reproducible SI onramp + marketplace bundle.
Omar: Key sections to include: compatibility matrix, installation steps (helm + kustomize), offline bundle notes, and perf tuning. Keep it concise.
Hyejin: Add a troubleshooting appendix: common failures (auth exchange failure, KV cache cold start, streaming chunk loss) and exact commands to gather logs.
Tess: Agreed. Minimal install outline: helm install + set tokenExchange.enabled=true + run smoke test script. We'll provide example smoke tests that check streaming, function-call wiring, and token auth exchange.
Omar: For HW partners: include tested SKUs (a100-40g, h100-80g) and suggested nodeSelector labels. Recommend default modelVariant: base-int8, with fallback to base-fp16.
BuildBot: CI: chart lint passed. Artifact: ghcr.io/redwood/ecosys-adapter:v0.1.1 pushed (sha:abcd1234). Smoke tests queued.
Hyejin: Marketing/legal asks: a short data handling statement for marketplace and a co-brand approval checklist for LangChain. I'll draft both.
Carlos: For SI handoff, include a 'bundle' script that creates a tar of images + chart + SBOM + cosign sigs. Also doc the cosign pubkey step for offline installs.
Tess: Action items:
- Omar: compatibility matrix + nodeSelector examples (due Wed)
- Hyejin: troubleshooting appendix + legal blurb draft (due Thu)
- Carlos: bundle script + SBOM example (due Wed)
- Tess: smoke test scripts + sample app (due Thu)
Tess: Sync Friday 9am PT to sign off assets before partner upload. Anyone blocked?
Omar: All good.
Hyejin: I'll be there.
Carlos: OK.
